    (c : Middle2_Category C) -> (d : Target_Category D) ->
    (F : ABC_Base_First_Functor A B a b) ->
    (G : ABC_Base_First_Functor A B a b) ->
    (H : ABC_Base_Second_Functor B C b c) ->
    (K : BCD_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) ->
    (alpha : ABC_First_NatTrans A B a b F G) -> (0 x : A) ->
    Target (Target_Hom D d (K.1 (H.1 (F.1 x))) (K.1 (H.1 (G.1 x))))
      ((ABD_whiskerLeft A B D a b d
        (BCD_Base_compFunctor B C D b c d H K) F G alpha).1 x)
      ((ACD_whiskerLeft A C D a c d K
        (ABC_Base_compFunctor A B C a b c F H)
        (ABC_Base_compFunctor A B C a b c G H)
        (ABC_whiskerLeft A B C a b c H F G alpha)).1 x) :=
  fun (0 A : Sort (succ u)) (0 B : Sort (succ w))
      (0 C : Sort (succ p)) (0 D : Sort (succ r))
      (a : Source_Category A) (b : Middle1_Category B)
      (c : Middle2_Category C) (d : Target_Category D)
      (F : ABC_Base_First_Functor A B a b)
      (G : ABC_Base_First_Functor A B a b)
      (H : ABC_Base_Second_Functor B C b c)
      (K : BCD_Base_Second_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : ABC_First_NatTrans A B a b F G) (0 x : A) =>

| mechIsTrue : (0 proof : P) -> MechDecidable P

def MechPi : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) -> B x

def MechSigma : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) * B x

  fun (0 A : Type 0) (no : A) (yes : A) (b : MechBool) =>
    case b as self in MechBool return A with
    | mechFalse => no
    | mechTrue => yes

  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechEmpty) =>
    case e as self in MechEmpty return A with

def mechFalseElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechFalse -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechFalse) =>
    case e as self in MechFalse return A with

def mechSumRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) ->
    (0 C : Type 0) -> (A -> C) -> (B -> C) -> MechSum A B -> C :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 C : Type 0)
    (left : A -> C) (right : B -> C) (s : MechSum A B) =>
      case s as self in MechSum return C with
      | mechInl a => left a
      | mechInr b => right b

    ((n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) -> (n : MechNat) -> P n :=
  fun (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) (zero : P mechZero)
    (step : (n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) (n : MechNat) =>
      case n as self in MechNat return P self with
      | mechZero => zero

    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0) ->
    P x (mechRefl A x) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechEq A x y) -> P y e :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A)
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0)
    (reflCase : P x (mechRefl A x)) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return P right self with
      | mechReflCtor => reflCase

def mechTransport : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> B x -> B y :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) (value : B x) =>
      mechJ A x (fun (0 right : A) (0 proof : MechEq A x right) => B right)
        value y e

def mechSymm : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
    case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq A right x with
    | mechReflCtor => mechRefl A x

def mechTrans : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 z : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y z -> MechEq A x z :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (0 z : A)
    (first : MechEq A x y) (second : MechEq A y z) =>
      case second as self in MechEq right return MechEq A x right with
      | mechReflCtor => first

def mechCongr : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) -> (0 f : A -> B) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> MechEq B (f x) (f y) :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 f : A -> B)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq B (f x) (f right) with
      | mechReflCtor => mechRefl B (f x)

-- The older proof equality has a relevant constructor witness, so it
-- remains an example whose elimination into data is rejected.
mu MechProofEq (0 A : Prop) : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechProofReflCtor : (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x

def mechProofRefl : (0 A : Prop) -> (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Prop) (x : A) => mechProofReflCtor x

def mechProofJ : (0 A : Prop) ->
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop) ->
    ((x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x)) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechProofEq A x y) -> P x y e :=
  fun (0 A : Prop)
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop)
    (reflCase : (x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x))
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechProofEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechProofEq left right return P left right self with
      | mechProofReflCtor witness => reflCase witness

-- Load category-core, heterogeneous-functor, composable-functors
-- and heterogeneous-whiskering first.
-- Four independent category families are shared by all four triangles.
poly (u, v, w, z, p, q, r, s) group MechIteratedWhiskering where
specialize MechCategoryCore (u, v) as Source
specialize MechCategoryCore (w, z) as Middle1
specialize MechCategoryCore (p, q) as Middle2
specialize MechCategoryCore (r, s) as Target
specialize MechHeterogeneousWhiskering (u, v, w, z, p, q) as ABC
  with (Base_Source := Source, Base_Middle := Middle1, Base_Target := Middle2)
specialize MechHeterogeneousWhiskering (w, z, p, q, r, s) as BCD
  with (Base_Source := Middle1, Base_Middle := Middle2, Base_Target := Target)
specialize MechHeterogeneousWhiskering (u, v, p, q, r, s) as ACD
  with (Base_Source := Source, Base_Middle := Middle2, Base_Target := Target)
specialize MechHeterogeneousWhiskering (u, v, w, z, r, s) as ABD
  with (Base_Source := Source, Base_Middle := Middle1, Base_Target := Target)

-- Precomposing by a composite agrees with two successive precompositions.
def whiskerRightComp : (0 A : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 B : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 C : Sort (succ p)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ r)) ->
    (a : Source_Category A) -> (b : Middle1_Category B) ->
    (c : Middle2_Category C) -> (d : Target_Category D) ->
    (K : ABC_Base_First_Functor A B a b) ->
    (L : ABC_Base_Second_Functor B C b c) ->
    (F : BCD_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) ->
    (G : BCD_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) ->
    (alpha : BCD_Second_NatTrans C D c d F G) -> (0 x : A) ->
    Target (Target_Hom D d (F.1 (L.1 (K.1 x))) (G.1 (L.1 (K.1 x))))
      ((ACD_whiskerRight A C D a c d F G alpha
        (ABC_Base_compFunctor A B C a b c K L)).1 x)
      ((ABD_whiskerRight A B D a b d
        (BCD_Base_compFunctor B C D b c d L F)
        (BCD_Base_compFunctor B C D b c d L G)
        (BCD_whiskerRight B C D b c d F G alpha L) K).1 x) :=
  fun (0 A : Sort (succ u)) (0 B : Sort (succ w))
      (0 C : Sort (succ p)) (0 D : Sort (succ r))
      (a : Source_Category A) (b : Middle1_Category B)
      (c : Middle2_Category C) (d : Target_Category D)
      (K : ABC_Base_First_Functor A B a b)
      (L : ABC_Base_Second_Functor B C b c)
      (F : BCD_Base_Second_Functor C D c d)
      (G : BCD_Base_Second_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : BCD_Second_NatTrans C D c d F G) (0 x : A) =>
    categoryRefl

-- Postcomposing by a composite agrees with two successive postcompositions.
def whiskerLeftComp : (0 A : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 B : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 C : Sort (succ p)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ r)) ->
    (a : Source_Category A) -> (b : Middle1_Category B) ->
    (c : Middle2_Category C) -> (d : Target_Category D) ->
    (F : ABC_Base_First_Functor A B a b) ->
    (G : ABC_Base_First_Functor A B a b) ->
    (H : ABC_Base_Second_Functor B C b c) ->
    (K : BCD_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) ->
    (alpha : ABC_First_NatTrans A B a b F G) -> (0 x : A) ->
    Target (Target_Hom D d (K.1 (H.1 (F.1 x))) (K.1 (H.1 (G.1 x))))
      ((ABD_whiskerLeft A B D a b d
        (BCD_Base_compFunctor B C D b c d H K) F G alpha).1 x)
      ((ACD_whiskerLeft A C D a c d K
        (ABC_Base_compFunctor A B C a b c F H)
        (ABC_Base_compFunctor A B C a b c G H)
        (ABC_whiskerLeft A B C a b c H F G alpha)).1 x) :=
  fun (0 A : Sort (succ u)) (0 B : Sort (succ w))
      (0 C : Sort (succ p)) (0 D : Sort (succ r))
      (a : Source_Category A) (b : Middle1_Category B)
      (c : Middle2_Category C) (d : Target_Category D)
      (F : ABC_Base_First_Functor A B a b)
      (G : ABC_Base_First_Functor A B a b)
      (H : ABC_Base_Second_Functor B C b c)
      (K : BCD_Base_Second_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : ABC_First_NatTrans A B a b F G) (0 x : A) =>
    categoryRefl

-- Precomposition and postcomposition commute on components.
def whiskerCommute : (0 A : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 B : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 C : Sort (succ p)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ r)) ->
    (a : Source_Category A) -> (b : Middle1_Category B) ->
    (c : Middle2_Category C) -> (d : Target_Category D) ->
    (K : ABC_Base_First_Functor A B a b) ->
    (F : ABC_Base_Second_Functor B C b c) ->
    (G : ABC_Base_Second_Functor B C b c) ->
    (H : BCD_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) ->
    (alpha : ABC_Second_NatTrans B C b c F G) -> (0 x : A) ->
    Target (Target_Hom D d (H.1 (F.1 (K.1 x))) (H.1 (G.1 (K.1 x))))
      ((ACD_whiskerLeft A C D a c d H
        (ABC_Base_compFunctor A B C a b c K F)
        (ABC_Base_compFunctor A B C a b c K G)
        (ABC_whiskerRight A B C a b c F G alpha K)).1 x)
      ((ABD_whiskerRight A B D a b d
        (BCD_Base_compFunctor B C D b c d F H)
        (BCD_Base_compFunctor B C D b c d G H)
        (BCD_whiskerLeft B C D b c d H F G alpha) K).1 x) :=
  fun (0 A : Sort (succ u)) (0 B : Sort (succ w))
      (0 C : Sort (succ p)) (0 D : Sort (succ r))
      (a : Source_Category A) (b : Middle1_Category B)
      (c : Middle2_Category C) (d : Target_Category D)
      (K : ABC_Base_First_Functor A B a b)
      (F : ABC_Base_Second_Functor B C b c)
      (G : ABC_Base_Second_Functor B C b c)
      (H : BCD_Base_Second_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : ABC_Second_NatTrans B C b c F G) (0 x : A) =>
    categoryRefl
end

-- Load shared-left-kan and its prerequisites before this group.
-- These laws compare components, with the shared target equality family.
poly (u, v, w, z, p, q) group MechLeftKanLaws where
  specialize MechSharedLeftKan (u, v, w, z, p, q) as Base

def CoconeEq : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ p)) -> (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) ->
    (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) -> (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (K : Base_Base_First_Base_Functor J C j c) ->
    (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d) ->
    (G : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G ->
    Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G -> Prop :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C)
      (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D)
      (K : Base_Base_First_Base_Functor J C j c)
      (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d)
      (G : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G)
      (beta : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) =>
    (x : J) -> Base_Base_Target (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x)))
      (alpha.1 x) (beta.1 x)

-- Solving the unit cocone gives the identity mediator at every object.
def descId : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ p)) -> (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) ->
    (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) -> (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (K : Base_Base_First_Base_Functor J C j c) ->
    (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d) ->
    (H : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (eta : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) ->
    (s : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H H eta eta) ->
    (y : C) -> Base_Base_Target (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (H.1 y) (H.1 y))
      ((s.1).1 y) (Base_Base_Target_id D d (H.1 y)) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C)
      (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D)
      (K : Base_Base_First_Base_Functor J C j c)
      (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d)
      (H : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (eta : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F H)
      (s : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H H eta eta) (y : C) =>
    Base_Base_Second_targetEqSymm (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (H.1 y) (H.1 y))
      (Base_Base_Target_id D d (H.1 y)) ((s.1).1 y)
      (Base_Lan_lanUniq J C D j c d K F H H eta eta s
        (Base_Base_Second_idNat C D c d H)
        (fun (x : J) => Base_Base_Target_compId D d (F.1 x) (H.1 (K.1 x)) (eta.1 x)) y)

-- Equal cocones have equal chosen mediators, even with different solutions.
def descCongr : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ p)) -> (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) ->
    (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) -> (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (K : Base_Base_First_Base_Functor J C j c) ->
    (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d) ->
    (H : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (G : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (eta : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) ->
    (alpha : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
    (beta : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
    (s : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) ->
    (t : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta beta) ->
    CoconeEq J C D j c d K F G alpha beta ->
    (y : C) -> Base_Base_Target (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y))
      ((s.1).1 y) ((t.1).1 y) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C)
      (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D)
      (K : Base_Base_First_Base_Functor J C j c)
      (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d)
      (H : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (G : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (eta : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F H)
      (alpha : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G)
      (beta : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G)
      (s : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha)
      (t : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta beta)
      (equal : CoconeEq J C D j c d K F G alpha beta) (y : C) =>
    Base_Lan_lanUniq J C D j c d K F H G eta beta t (s.1)
      (fun (x : J) =>
        Base_Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x)))
          (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (H.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 x))
            (eta.1 x) ((s.1).1 (K.1 x))) (alpha.1 x) (beta.1 x)
          (Base_Lan_lanFac J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha s x) (equal x)) y

-- Postcompose a cocone by a transformation on the middle category.
def postCocone : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ p)) -> (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) ->
    (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) -> (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (K : Base_Base_First_Base_Functor J C j c) ->
    (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d) ->
    (G : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (I : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G ->
    Base_Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d G I -> Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F I :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C)
      (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D)
      (K : Base_Base_First_Base_Functor J C j c)
      (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d)
      (G : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (I : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G)
      (tau : Base_Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d G I) =>
    Base_Base_Composite_vcomp J D j d F
      (Base_Base_Compose_Base_compFunctor J C D j c d K G)
      (Base_Base_Compose_Base_compFunctor J C D j c d K I) alpha
      (Base_Base_Compose_whiskerRight J C D j c d G I tau K)

-- Postcomposition commutes with choosing the universal mediator.
def descPostcomp : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ p)) -> (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) ->
    (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) -> (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (K : Base_Base_First_Base_Functor J C j c) ->
    (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d) ->
    (H : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (G : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (I : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (eta : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) ->
    (alpha : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
    (tau : Base_Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d G I) ->
    (s : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) ->
    (t : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H I eta
      (postCocone J C D j c d K F G I alpha tau)) ->
    (y : C) -> Base_Base_Target (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (H.1 y) (I.1 y))
      (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y) (I.1 y) ((s.1).1 y) (tau.1 y))
      ((t.1).1 y) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C)
      (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D)
      (K : Base_Base_First_Base_Functor J C j c)
      (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d)
      (H : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (G : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (I : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (eta : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F H)
      (alpha : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G)
      (tau : Base_Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d G I)
      (s : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha)
      (t : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H I eta
        (postCocone J C D j c d K F G I alpha tau)) (y : C) =>
    Base_Lan_lanUniq J C D j c d K F H I eta
      (postCocone J C D j c d K F G I alpha tau) t
      (Base_Base_Second_vcomp C D c d H G I (s.1) tau)
      (fun (x : J) =>
        Base_Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (I.1 (K.1 x)))
          (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (H.1 (K.1 x)) (I.1 (K.1 x)) (eta.1 x)
            (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (H.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 x)) (I.1 (K.1 x))
              ((s.1).1 (K.1 x)) (tau.1 (K.1 x))))
          (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x)) (I.1 (K.1 x))
            (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (H.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 x))
              (eta.1 x) ((s.1).1 (K.1 x))) (tau.1 (K.1 x)))
          (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x)) (I.1 (K.1 x))
            (alpha.1 x) (tau.1 (K.1 x)))
          (Base_Base_Second_targetEqSymm (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (I.1 (K.1 x)))
            (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x)) (I.1 (K.1 x))
              (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (H.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 x))
                (eta.1 x) ((s.1).1 (K.1 x))) (tau.1 (K.1 x)))
            (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (H.1 (K.1 x)) (I.1 (K.1 x)) (eta.1 x)
              (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (H.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 x)) (I.1 (K.1 x))
                ((s.1).1 (K.1 x)) (tau.1 (K.1 x))))
            (Base_Base_Target_assoc D d (F.1 x) (H.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 x)) (I.1 (K.1 x))
              (eta.1 x) ((s.1).1 (K.1 x)) (tau.1 (K.1 x))))
          (Base_Base_Target_eqCongr (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x)))
            (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (I.1 (K.1 x)))
            (fun (h : Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x))) =>
              Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x)) (I.1 (K.1 x)) h (tau.1 (K.1 x)))
            (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (H.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 x))
              (eta.1 x) ((s.1).1 (K.1 x))) (alpha.1 x)
            (Base_Lan_lanFac J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha s x))) y
end

-- Checked data at the first data universe.  No declaration uses the
-- driver's initial Nat axiom or its literal primitives.

mu MechNat : Type 0 with
| mechZero : MechNat
| mechSucc : MechNat -> MechNat

mu MechBool : Type 0 with
| mechFalse : MechBool
| mechTrue : MechBool

mu MechUnit : Type 0 with
| mechUnit : MechUnit

mu MechEmpty : Type 0 with

mu MechFalse : Prop with

mu MechTrue : Prop with
| mechTrivial : MechTrue

mu MechSum (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) : Type 0 with
| mechInl : A -> MechSum A B
| mechInr : B -> MechSum A B

mu MechDecidable (0 P : Prop) : Type 0 with
| mechIsFalse : (0 refute : P -> MechFalse) -> MechDecidable P
| mechIsTrue : (0 proof : P) -> MechDecidable P

def MechPi : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) -> B x

def MechSigma : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) * B x

def mechBoolRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> A -> A -> MechBool -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (no : A) (yes : A) (b : MechBool) =>
    case b as self in MechBool return A with
    | mechFalse => no
    | mechTrue => yes

def mechEmptyElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechEmpty -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechEmpty) =>
    case e as self in MechEmpty return A with

def mechFalseElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechFalse -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechFalse) =>
    case e as self in MechFalse return A with

def mechSumRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) ->
    (0 C : Type 0) -> (A -> C) -> (B -> C) -> MechSum A B -> C :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 C : Type 0)
    (left : A -> C) (right : B -> C) (s : MechSum A B) =>
      case s as self in MechSum return C with
      | mechInl a => left a
      | mechInr b => right b

def rec mechNatRec : (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) -> P mechZero ->
    ((n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) -> (n : MechNat) -> P n :=
  fun (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) (zero : P mechZero)
    (step : (n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) (n : MechNat) =>
      case n as self in MechNat return P self with
      | mechZero => zero
      | mechSucc previous => step previous (mechNatRec P zero step previous)

def mechDecidableBool : (0 P : Prop) -> MechDecidable P -> MechBool :=
  fun (0 P : Prop) (d : MechDecidable P) =>
    case d as self in MechDecidable return MechBool with
    | mechIsFalse 0 refute => mechFalse
    | mechIsTrue 0 proof => mechTrue

-- Equality keeps its endpoints erased and carries no constructor field.
-- The singleton criterion therefore admits elimination into data.
mu MechEq (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) : (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechReflCtor : MechEq A x x

def mechRefl : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> MechEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) => mechReflCtor

def mechJ : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) ->
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0) ->
    P x (mechRefl A x) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechEq A x y) -> P y e :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A)
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0)
    (reflCase : P x (mechRefl A x)) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return P right self with
      | mechReflCtor => reflCase

def mechTransport : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> B x -> B y :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) (value : B x) =>
      mechJ A x (fun (0 right : A) (0 proof : MechEq A x right) => B right)
        value y e

def mechSymm : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
    case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq A right x with
    | mechReflCtor => mechRefl A x

def mechTrans : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 z : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y z -> MechEq A x z :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (0 z : A)
    (first : MechEq A x y) (second : MechEq A y z) =>
      case second as self in MechEq right return MechEq A x right with
      | mechReflCtor => first

def mechCongr : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) -> (0 f : A -> B) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> MechEq B (f x) (f y) :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 f : A -> B)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq B (f x) (f right) with
      | mechReflCtor => mechRefl B (f x)

-- The older proof equality has a relevant constructor witness, so it
-- remains an example whose elimination into data is rejected.
mu MechProofEq (0 A : Prop) : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechProofReflCtor : (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x

def mechProofRefl : (0 A : Prop) -> (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Prop) (x : A) => mechProofReflCtor x

def mechProofJ : (0 A : Prop) ->
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop) ->
    ((x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x)) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechProofEq A x y) -> P x y e :=
  fun (0 A : Prop)
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop)
    (reflCase : (x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x))
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechProofEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechProofEq left right return P left right self with
      | mechProofReflCtor witness => reflCase witness

-- Load shared-left-kan and its prerequisites before this group.
-- These laws compare components, with the shared target equality family.
poly (u, v, w, z, p, q) group MechLeftKanLaws where

def CoconeEq : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ w)) ->

    (x : J) -> Base_Base_Target (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x)))

-- Solving the unit cocone gives the identity mediator at every object.
def descId : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ p)) -> (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) ->
    (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) -> (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D) ->

  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))

      (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D)

      (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d)
      (H : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (eta : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F H)

    Base_Base_Second_targetEqSymm (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (H.1 y) (H.1 y))
      (Base_Base_Target_id D d (H.1 y)) ((s.1).1 y)
      (Base_Lan_lanUniq J C D j c d K F H H eta eta s
        (Base_Base_Second_idNat C D c d H)
        (fun (x : J) => Base_Base_Target_compId D d (F.1 x) (H.1 (K.1 x)) (eta.1 x)) y)

-- Equal cocones have equal chosen mediators, even with different solutions.
def descCongr : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ p)) -> (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) ->
    (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) -> (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (K : Base_Base_First_Base_Functor J C j c) ->
    (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d) ->

    (beta : Base_Lan_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
    (s : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) ->
    (t : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta beta) ->
    CoconeEq J C D j c d K F G alpha beta ->
    (y : C) -> Base_Base_Target (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y))

  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C)
      (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D)
      (K : Base_Base_First_Base_Functor J C j c)
      (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d)

            (eta.1 x) ((s.1).1 (K.1 x))) (alpha.1 x) (beta.1 x)

-- Postcompose a cocone by a transformation on the middle category.
def postCocone : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ p)) -> (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) ->
    (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) -> (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D) ->

      (Base_Base_Compose_whiskerRight J C D j c d G I tau K)

      (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y) (I.1 y) ((s.1).1 y) (tau.1 y))
      ((t.1).1 y) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C)
      (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D)
      (K : Base_Base_First_Base_Functor J C j c)
      (F : Base_Base_Composite_Base_Functor J D j d)
      (H : Base_Base_Second_Base_Functor C D c d)

      (tau : Base_Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d G I)
      (s : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha)
      (t : Base_Lan_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H I eta
        (postCocone J C D j c d K F G I alpha tau)) (y : C) =>
    Base_Lan_lanUniq J C D j c d K F H I eta
      (postCocone J C D j c d K F G I alpha tau) t

      (fun (x : J) =>
        Base_Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (I.1 (K.1 x)))
          (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (H.1 (K.1 x)) (I.1 (K.1 x)) (eta.1 x)
            (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (H.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 x)) (I.1 (K.1 x))
              ((s.1).1 (K.1 x)) (tau.1 (K.1 x))))

-- Checked data at the first data universe.  No declaration uses the
-- driver's initial Nat axiom or its literal primitives.

mu MechNat : Type 0 with
| mechZero : MechNat
| mechSucc : MechNat -> MechNat

mu MechBool : Type 0 with
| mechFalse : MechBool
| mechTrue : MechBool

mu MechUnit : Type 0 with
| mechUnit : MechUnit

mu MechEmpty : Type 0 with

mu MechFalse : Prop with

mu MechTrue : Prop with
| mechTrivial : MechTrue

mu MechSum (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) : Type 0 with
| mechInl : A -> MechSum A B
| mechInr : B -> MechSum A B

mu MechDecidable (0 P : Prop) : Type 0 with
| mechIsFalse : (0 refute : P -> MechFalse) -> MechDecidable P
| mechIsTrue : (0 proof : P) -> MechDecidable P

def MechPi : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) -> B x

def MechSigma : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) * B x

def mechBoolRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> A -> A -> MechBool -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (no : A) (yes : A) (b : MechBool) =>
    case b as self in MechBool return A with
    | mechFalse => no
    | mechTrue => yes

def mechEmptyElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechEmpty -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechEmpty) =>
    case e as self in MechEmpty return A with

def mechFalseElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechFalse -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechFalse) =>
    case e as self in MechFalse return A with

def mechSumRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) ->
    (0 C : Type 0) -> (A -> C) -> (B -> C) -> MechSum A B -> C :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 C : Type 0)
    (left : A -> C) (right : B -> C) (s : MechSum A B) =>
      case s as self in MechSum return C with
      | mechInl a => left a
      | mechInr b => right b

def rec mechNatRec : (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) -> P mechZero ->
    ((n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) -> (n : MechNat) -> P n :=
  fun (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) (zero : P mechZero)
    (step : (n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) (n : MechNat) =>
      case n as self in MechNat return P self with
      | mechZero => zero
      | mechSucc previous => step previous (mechNatRec P zero step previous)

def mechDecidableBool : (0 P : Prop) -> MechDecidable P -> MechBool :=
  fun (0 P : Prop) (d : MechDecidable P) =>
    case d as self in MechDecidable return MechBool with
    | mechIsFalse 0 refute => mechFalse
    | mechIsTrue 0 proof => mechTrue

-- Equality keeps its endpoints erased and carries no constructor field.
-- The singleton criterion therefore admits elimination into data.
mu MechEq (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) : (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechReflCtor : MechEq A x x

def mechRefl : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> MechEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) => mechReflCtor

def mechJ : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) ->
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0) ->
    P x (mechRefl A x) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechEq A x y) -> P y e :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A)
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0)
    (reflCase : P x (mechRefl A x)) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return P right self with
      | mechReflCtor => reflCase

def mechTransport : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> B x -> B y :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) (value : B x) =>
      mechJ A x (fun (0 right : A) (0 proof : MechEq A x right) => B right)
        value y e

def mechSymm : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
    case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq A right x with
    | mechReflCtor => mechRefl A x

def mechTrans : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 z : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y z -> MechEq A x z :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (0 z : A)
    (first : MechEq A x y) (second : MechEq A y z) =>
      case second as self in MechEq right return MechEq A x right with
      | mechReflCtor => first

def mechCongr : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) -> (0 f : A -> B) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> MechEq B (f x) (f y) :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 f : A -> B)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq B (f x) (f right) with
      | mechReflCtor => mechRefl B (f x)

-- The older proof equality has a relevant constructor witness, so it
-- remains an example whose elimination into data is rejected.
mu MechProofEq (0 A : Prop) : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechProofReflCtor : (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x

def mechProofRefl : (0 A : Prop) -> (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Prop) (x : A) => mechProofReflCtor x

def mechProofJ : (0 A : Prop) ->
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop) ->
    ((x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x)) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechProofEq A x y) -> P x y e :=
  fun (0 A : Prop)
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop)
    (reflCase : (x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x))
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechProofEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechProofEq left right return P left right self with
      | mechProofReflCtor witness => reflCase witness

def NatTransEq : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->

-- Load shared-nattrans.mech and identity-functor.mech with their dependencies first.
-- Unit equations compare components, with independent source and target universes.
poly (u, v, w, z) group MechNatTransUnits where
specialize MechCategoryCore (u, v) as Source
specialize MechCategoryCore (w, z) as Target
specialize MechIdentityFunctor (u, v) as SourceIdentity with (Base := Source)
specialize MechIdentityFunctor (w, z) as TargetIdentity with (Base := Target)
specialize MechSharedNatTrans (u, v, u, v, w, z) as Before
  with (Source := Source, Middle := Source, Target := Target)
specialize MechSharedNatTrans (u, v, w, z, w, z) as After
  with (Source := Source, Middle := Target, Target := Target)

def whiskerRightIdFunctor : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (c : Source_Category C) -> (d : Target_Category D) ->
    (F : Before_Second_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (G : Before_Second_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (alpha : Before_Second_NatTrans C D c d F G) -> (x : C) ->
    Target (Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x))
      ((Before_Compose_whiskerRight C C D c c d F G alpha
        (SourceIdentity_idFunctor C c)).1 x) (alpha.1 x) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w))
      (c : Source_Category C) (d : Target_Category D)
      (F : Before_Second_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (G : Before_Second_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : Before_Second_NatTrans C D c d F G) (x : C) => categoryRefl

def whiskerLeftIdFunctor : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (c : Source_Category C) -> (d : Target_Category D) ->
    (F : After_First_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (G : After_First_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (alpha : After_First_NatTrans C D c d F G) -> (x : C) ->
    Target (Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x))
      ((After_Compose_whiskerLeft C D D c d d
        (TargetIdentity_idFunctor D d) F G alpha).1 x) (alpha.1 x) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w))
      (c : Source_Category C) (d : Target_Category D)
      (F : After_First_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (G : After_First_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : After_First_NatTrans C D c d F G) (x : C) => categoryRefl

-- The identity transformation is on the source identity functor.
def hcompIdFunctorLeft : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (c : Source_Category C) -> (d : Target_Category D) ->
    (F : Before_Second_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (G : Before_Second_Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (alpha : Before_Second_NatTrans C D c d F G) -> (x : C) ->
    Target (Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x))

    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechProofEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechProofEq left right return P left right self with
      | mechProofReflCtor witness => reflCase witness

-- Load prelude/init.mech first. All proofs use structural naturals.
-- A choice describes allocation of one indivisible bundle.
def rec AuctionLe : MechNat -> MechNat -> Prop :=
  fun (lower : MechNat) (upper : MechNat) =>
    case lower as self in MechNat return Prop with
    | mechZero => MechTrue
    | mechSucc previous =>
      case upper as other in MechNat return Prop with
      | mechZero => MechFalse
      | mechSucc next => AuctionLe previous next

def auctionLeZero : (0 upper : MechNat) -> AuctionLe mechZero upper :=
  fun (0 upper : MechNat) => mechTrivial
def auctionLeSucc : (0 lower : MechNat) -> (0 upper : MechNat) ->
    (proof : AuctionLe lower upper) -> AuctionLe (mechSucc lower) (mechSucc upper) :=
  fun (0 lower : MechNat) (0 upper : MechNat) (proof : AuctionLe lower upper) => proof

mu AuctionChoice : Type 0 with
| auctionLose : AuctionChoice
| auctionWin : AuctionChoice

-- Both branches admit equality: the fixed priority chooses the tie branch.
mu AuctionOrder (0 bid : MechNat) (0 price : MechNat) : Type 0 with
| auctionAbove : (proof : AuctionLe price bid) -> AuctionOrder bid price
| auctionBelow : (proof : AuctionLe bid price) -> AuctionOrder bid price

def rec auctionCompare : MechBool -> (bid : MechNat) -> (price : MechNat) ->
    AuctionOrder bid price :=
  fun (tieWins : MechBool) (bid : MechNat) (price : MechNat) =>
    case bid as self in MechNat return AuctionOrder self price with
    | mechZero => (
      case price as threshold in MechNat return AuctionOrder mechZero threshold with
      | mechZero => (
        case tieWins as priority in MechBool return AuctionOrder mechZero mechZero with
        | mechFalse => auctionBelow (auctionLeZero mechZero)
        | mechTrue => auctionAbove (auctionLeZero mechZero))
      | mechSucc previous => auctionBelow (auctionLeZero (mechSucc previous)))
    | mechSucc previous => (
      case price as threshold in MechNat return AuctionOrder (mechSucc previous) threshold with
      | mechZero => auctionAbove (auctionLeZero (mechSucc previous))
      | mechSucc other =>
        case auctionCompare tieWins previous other as order in AuctionOrder
          return AuctionOrder (mechSucc previous) (mechSucc other) with
        | auctionAbove proof => auctionAbove (auctionLeSucc other previous proof)
        | auctionBelow proof => auctionBelow (auctionLeSucc previous other proof))

def auctionChoice : (0 bid : MechNat) -> (0 price : MechNat) ->
    AuctionOrder bid price -> AuctionChoice :=
  fun (0 bid : MechNat) (0 price : MechNat) (order : AuctionOrder bid price) =>
    case order as self in AuctionOrder return AuctionChoice with
    | auctionAbove proof => auctionWin
    | auctionBelow proof => auctionLose

def auctionAllocate : MechBool -> MechNat -> MechNat -> AuctionChoice :=
  fun (tieWins : MechBool) (bid : MechNat) (price : MechNat) =>
    auctionChoice bid price (auctionCompare tieWins bid price)

def auctionPayment : MechNat -> AuctionChoice -> MechNat :=
  fun (price : MechNat) (choice : AuctionChoice) =>
    case choice as self in AuctionChoice return MechNat with
    | auctionLose => mechZero
    | auctionWin => price

def auctionWinnerPaysThreshold : (0 price : MechNat) ->
    MechEq MechNat (auctionPayment price auctionWin) price :=
  fun (0 price : MechNat) => mechRefl MechNat price
def auctionLoserPaysZero : (0 price : MechNat) ->
    MechEq MechNat (auctionPayment price auctionLose) mechZero :=
  fun (0 price : MechNat) => mechRefl MechNat mechZero

-- This is the four-case normal form of signed quasi-linear utility:
-- u(v, win, price) = v - price and u(v, lose, price) = 0.
-- It does not truncate negative utility to zero.
def AuctionUtilityGe : MechNat -> MechNat -> AuctionChoice -> AuctionChoice -> Prop :=
  fun (value : MechNat) (price : MechNat) (truth : AuctionChoice) (deviation : AuctionChoice) =>
    case truth as self in AuctionChoice return Prop with
    | auctionLose => (
      case deviation as other in AuctionChoice return Prop with
      | auctionLose => MechTrue
      | auctionWin => AuctionLe value price)
    | auctionWin => (
      case deviation as other in AuctionChoice return Prop with
      | auctionLose => AuctionLe price value
      | auctionWin => MechTrue)

def auctionDominatesAnyChoice : (value : MechNat) -> (price : MechNat) ->
    (truth : AuctionOrder value price) -> (deviation : AuctionChoice) ->
    AuctionUtilityGe value price (auctionChoice value price truth) deviation :=
  fun (value : MechNat) (price : MechNat) (truth : AuctionOrder value price)
      (deviation : AuctionChoice) =>
    case truth as self in AuctionOrder
      return AuctionUtilityGe value price (auctionChoice value price self) deviation with
    | auctionAbove proof => (
      case deviation as other in AuctionChoice
        return AuctionUtilityGe value price auctionWin other with
      | auctionLose => proof
      | auctionWin => mechTrivial)
    | auctionBelow proof => (
      case deviation as other in AuctionChoice
        return AuctionUtilityGe value price auctionLose other with
      | auctionLose => mechTrivial
      | auctionWin => proof)

-- Price and tie priority are fixed by competing bids, independently of report.
def auctionIncentiveCompatible : (tieWins : MechBool) -> (price : MechNat) ->
    (value : MechNat) -> (report : MechNat) ->
    AuctionUtilityGe value price (auctionAllocate tieWins value price)
      (auctionAllocate tieWins report price) :=
  fun (tieWins : MechBool) (price : MechNat) (value : MechNat) (report : MechNat) =>
    auctionDominatesAnyChoice value price (auctionCompare tieWins value price)
      (auctionAllocate tieWins report price)

def auctionIndividualRational : (tieWins : MechBool) -> (price : MechNat) ->
    (value : MechNat) ->
    AuctionUtilityGe value price (auctionAllocate tieWins value price) auctionLose :=
  fun (tieWins : MechBool) (price : MechNat) (value : MechNat) =>
    auctionDominatesAnyChoice value price (auctionCompare tieWins value price) auctionLose

def auctionNoDeficit : (price : MechNat) -> (choice : AuctionChoice) ->
    AuctionLe mechZero (auctionPayment price choice) :=
  fun (price : MechNat) (choice : AuctionChoice) => auctionLeZero (auctionPayment price choice)

def auctionMax : MechNat -> MechNat -> MechNat :=
  fun (left : MechNat) (right : MechNat) =>
    case auctionAllocate mechTrue left right as choice in AuctionChoice return MechNat with
    | auctionLose => right
    | auctionWin => left

-- Bidder order A, B, C breaks all ties. B wins a tie with C only when A is lower.
def auctionPriorityB : MechNat -> MechNat -> MechBool :=
  fun (a : MechNat) (c : MechNat) =>
    case auctionAllocate mechTrue a c as choice in AuctionChoice return MechBool with
    | auctionLose => mechTrue
    | auctionWin => mechFalse

def auctionChoiceA : MechNat -> MechNat -> MechNat -> AuctionChoice :=
  fun (a : MechNat) (b : MechNat) (c : MechNat) => auctionAllocate mechTrue a (auctionMax b c)
def auctionChoiceB : MechNat -> MechNat -> MechNat -> AuctionChoice :=
  fun (a : MechNat) (b : MechNat) (c : MechNat) =>
    auctionAllocate (auctionPriorityB a c) b (auctionMax a c)
def auctionChoiceC : MechNat -> MechNat -> MechNat -> AuctionChoice :=
  fun (a : MechNat) (b : MechNat) (c : MechNat) => auctionAllocate mechFalse c (auctionMax a b)

def auctionPaymentA : MechNat -> MechNat -> MechNat -> MechNat :=
  fun (a : MechNat) (b : MechNat) (c : MechNat) => auctionPayment (auctionMax b c) (auctionChoiceA a b c)
def auctionPaymentB : MechNat -> MechNat -> MechNat -> MechNat :=
  fun (a : MechNat) (b : MechNat) (c : MechNat) => auctionPayment (auctionMax a c) (auctionChoiceB a b c)
def auctionPaymentC : MechNat -> MechNat -> MechNat -> MechNat :=
  fun (a : MechNat) (b : MechNat) (c : MechNat) => auctionPayment (auctionMax a b) (auctionChoiceC a b c)

def auctionTruthfulA : (value : MechNat) -> (report : MechNat) -> (b : MechNat) -> (c : MechNat) ->
    AuctionUtilityGe value (auctionMax b c) (auctionChoiceA value b c) (auctionChoiceA report b c) :=
  fun (value : MechNat) (report : MechNat) (b : MechNat) (c : MechNat) =>
    auctionIncentiveCompatible mechTrue (auctionMax b c) value report
def auctionTruthfulB : (a : MechNat) -> (value : MechNat) -> (report : MechNat) -> (c : MechNat) ->
    AuctionUtilityGe value (auctionMax a c) (auctionChoiceB a value c) (auctionChoiceB a report c) :=
  fun (a : MechNat) (value : MechNat) (report : MechNat) (c : MechNat) =>
    auctionIncentiveCompatible (auctionPriorityB a c) (auctionMax a c) value report
def auctionTruthfulC : (a : MechNat) -> (b : MechNat) -> (value : MechNat) -> (report : MechNat) ->
    AuctionUtilityGe value (auctionMax a b) (auctionChoiceC a b value) (auctionChoiceC a b report) :=
  fun (a : MechNat) (b : MechNat) (value : MechNat) (report : MechNat) =>
    auctionIncentiveCompatible mechFalse (auctionMax a b) value report

def rec auctionAdd : MechNat -> MechNat -> MechNat :=
  fun (left : MechNat) (right : MechNat) =>
    case left as self in MechNat return MechNat with
    | mechZero => right
    | mechSucc previous => mechSucc (auctionAdd previous right)

-- Native naturals occur only at the host boundary, outside the proof above.
def auctionToNative : MechNat -> Nat :=
  fun (n : MechNat) => mechNatRec (fun (value : MechNat) => Nat) 0

    case choice as self in AuctionChoice return Nat with
    | auctionLose => 0
    | auctionWin => 1

-- VCG utility is true total welfare minus an opponent-only pivot.

def rec vcgAdd : MechNat -> MechNat -> MechNat :=

    case right as self in MechNat return MechNat with
    | mechZero => left
    | mechSucc previous => mechSucc (vcgAdd left previous)

def rec vcgLeShift : (lower : MechNat) -> (upper : MechNat) -> (offset : MechNat) ->

  fun (lower : MechNat) (upper : MechNat) (offset : MechNat) (bound : AuctionLe lower upper) =>
    case offset as self in MechNat
      return AuctionLe (vcgAdd lower self) (vcgAdd upper self) with
    | mechZero => bound
    | mechSucc previous => vcgLeShift lower upper previous bound

def rec vcgLeUnshift : (lower : MechNat) -> (upper : MechNat) -> (offset : MechNat) ->
    AuctionLe (vcgAdd lower offset) (vcgAdd upper offset) -> AuctionLe lower upper :=
  fun (lower : MechNat) (upper : MechNat) (offset : MechNat) =>
    case offset as self in MechNat
      return AuctionLe (vcgAdd lower self) (vcgAdd upper self) -> AuctionLe lower upper with
    | mechZero => fun (bound : AuctionLe lower upper) => bound
    | mechSucc previous =>

-- Cross addition preserves losses rather than truncating a negative utility.
def VcgUtilityGe : MechNat -> MechNat -> MechNat -> Prop :=
  fun (truth : MechNat) (deviation : MechNat) (pivot : MechNat) =>
    AuctionLe (vcgAdd deviation pivot) (vcgAdd truth pivot)

-- An allocation rule must maximize welfare over every feasible outcome.
def VcgOptimal : (0 Allocation : Type 0) -> (Allocation -> MechNat) ->
    (Allocation -> Prop) -> Allocation -> Prop :=
  fun (0 Allocation : Type 0) (welfare : Allocation -> MechNat)
      (feasible : Allocation -> Prop) (selected : Allocation) =>
    (alternative : Allocation) -> feasible alternative -> AuctionLe (welfare alternative) (welfare selected)

-- Given the truthful welfare optimum, any feasible deviating outcome has
-- weakly smaller signed utility. The pivot cannot depend on this tenant's report.
def vcgIncentiveCompatible : (0 Allocation : Type 0) -> (welfare : Allocation -> MechNat) ->
    (feasible : Allocation -> Prop) -> (truth : Allocation) -> (deviation : Allocation) ->
    VcgOptimal Allocation welfare feasible truth -> feasible deviation -> (pivot : MechNat) ->
    VcgUtilityGe (welfare truth) (welfare deviation) pivot :=
  fun (0 Allocation : Type 0) (welfare : Allocation -> MechNat) (feasible : Allocation -> Prop)
      (truth : Allocation) (deviation : Allocation)
      (optimal : VcgOptimal Allocation welfare feasible truth) (allowed : feasible deviation)
      (pivot : MechNat) =>
    vcgLeShift (welfare deviation) (welfare truth) pivot (optimal deviation allowed)

def vcgLeLeft : (0 left : MechNat) -> (0 replacement : MechNat) -> (upper : MechNat) ->
    MechEq MechNat left replacement -> AuctionLe left upper -> AuctionLe replacement upper :=
  fun (0 left : MechNat) (0 replacement : MechNat) (upper : MechNat)
      (equality : MechEq MechNat left replacement) (bound : AuctionLe left upper) =>
    case equality as self in MechEq right return AuctionLe right upper with
    | mechReflCtor => bound

def vcgLeRight : (lower : MechNat) -> (0 right : MechNat) -> (0 replacement : MechNat) ->
    MechEq MechNat right replacement -> AuctionLe lower right -> AuctionLe lower replacement :=
  fun (lower : MechNat) (0 right : MechNat) (0 replacement : MechNat)
      (equality : MechEq MechNat right replacement) (bound : AuctionLe lower right) =>
    case equality as self in MechEq upper return AuctionLe lower upper with
    | mechReflCtor => bound

-- The pivot identity defines the Clarke payment: payment + others = pivot.
-- Efficiency includes the outcome selected when this tenant is absent.
def vcgIndividualRational : (value : MechNat) -> (payment : MechNat) -> (others : MechNat) ->
    (welfare : MechNat) -> (pivot : MechNat) ->
    MechEq MechNat (vcgAdd value others) welfare ->
    MechEq MechNat (vcgAdd payment others) pivot ->
    AuctionLe pivot welfare -> AuctionLe payment value :=
  fun (value : MechNat) (payment : MechNat) (others : MechNat) (welfare : MechNat) (pivot : MechNat)
      (total : MechEq MechNat (vcgAdd value others) welfare)
      (externality : MechEq MechNat (vcgAdd payment others) pivot) (efficient : AuctionLe pivot welfare) =>
    vcgLeUnshift payment value others
      (vcgLeRight (vcgAdd payment others) welfare (vcgAdd value others)
        (mechSymm MechNat (vcgAdd value others) welfare total)
        (vcgLeLeft pivot (vcgAdd payment others) welfare
          (mechSymm MechNat (vcgAdd payment others) pivot externality) efficient))

-- Every accepted payment is a natural satisfying the pivot identity above.
-- Their sum is therefore a nonnegative revenue, without seller subsidies.
def vcgNoDeficit : (revenue : MechNat) -> AuctionLe mechZero revenue :=
  fun (revenue : MechNat) => auctionLeZero revenue

-- Exact native arithmetic is used only by closed instance certificates.
-- The generated certificate checks both subtraction preconditions and identities.
def vcgNativePayment : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat :=
  fun (welfare : Nat) (own : Nat) (without : Nat) => natSub without (natSub welfare own)

    case b as self in MechBool return A with

-- Efficiency includes the outcome selected when this tenant is absent.

    (welfare : MechNat) -> (pivot : MechNat) ->
    MechEq MechNat (vcgAdd value others) welfare ->
    MechEq MechNat (vcgAdd payment others) pivot ->
    AuctionLe pivot welfare -> AuctionLe payment value :=
  fun (value : MechNat) (payment : MechNat) (others : MechNat) (welfare : MechNat) (pivot : MechNat)
      (total : MechEq MechNat (vcgAdd value others) welfare)
      (externality : MechEq MechNat (vcgAdd payment others) pivot) (efficient : AuctionLe pivot welfare) =>
    vcgLeUnshift payment value others
      (vcgLeRight (vcgAdd payment others) welfare (vcgAdd value others)
        (mechSymm MechNat (vcgAdd value others) welfare total)
        (vcgLeLeft pivot (vcgAdd payment others) welfare
          (mechSymm MechNat (vcgAdd payment others) pivot externality) efficient))

  fun (revenue : MechNat) => auctionLeZero revenue

      case s as self in MechSum return C with
      | mechInl a => left a

    ((n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) -> (n : MechNat) -> P n :=
  fun (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) (zero : P mechZero)

      case n as self in MechNat return P self with
      | mechZero => zero
      | mechSucc previous => step previous (mechNatRec P zero step previous)

-- Equality keeps its endpoints erased and carries no constructor field.
-- The singleton criterion therefore admits elimination into data.
mu MechEq (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) : (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechReflCtor : MechEq A x x

def mechRefl : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> MechEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) => mechReflCtor

def mechJ : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) ->
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0) ->
    P x (mechRefl A x) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechEq A x y) -> P y e :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A)
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0)
    (reflCase : P x (mechRefl A x)) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return P right self with
      | mechReflCtor => reflCase

    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> B x -> B y :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) (value : B x) =>
      mechJ A x (fun (0 right : A) (0 proof : MechEq A x right) => B right)
        value y e

  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
    case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq A right x with
    | mechReflCtor => mechRefl A x

    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y z -> MechEq A x z :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (0 z : A)
    (first : MechEq A x y) (second : MechEq A y z) =>
      case second as self in MechEq right return MechEq A x right with
      | mechReflCtor => first

    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> MechEq B (f x) (f y) :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 f : A -> B)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq B (f x) (f right) with
      | mechReflCtor => mechRefl B (f x)

mu MechProofEq (0 A : Prop) : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechProofReflCtor : (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x

def mechProofRefl : (0 A : Prop) -> (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Prop) (x : A) => mechProofReflCtor x

def mechProofJ : (0 A : Prop) ->
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop) ->
    ((x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x)) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechProofEq A x y) -> P x y e :=
  fun (0 A : Prop)
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop)
    (reflCase : (x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x))
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechProofEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechProofEq left right return P left right self with
      | mechProofReflCtor witness => reflCase witness

-- Equality keeps its endpoints erased and carries no constructor field.
-- The singleton criterion therefore admits elimination into data.
mu MechEq (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) : (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechReflCtor : MechEq A x x

def mechRefl : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> MechEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) => mechReflCtor

    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0) ->
    P x (mechRefl A x) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechEq A x y) -> P y e :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A)
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0)
    (reflCase : P x (mechRefl A x)) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return P right self with
      | mechReflCtor => reflCase

    (reflCase : P x (mechRefl A x)) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return P right self with
      | mechReflCtor => reflCase

-- Checked data at the first data universe.  No declaration uses the
-- driver's initial Nat axiom or its literal primitives.

mu MechNat : Type 0 with
| mechZero : MechNat
| mechSucc : MechNat -> MechNat

mu MechBool : Type 0 with
| mechFalse : MechBool
| mechTrue : MechBool

mu MechUnit : Type 0 with
| mechUnit : MechUnit

mu MechEmpty : Type 0 with

mu MechFalse : Prop with

mu MechTrue : Prop with
| mechTrivial : MechTrue

mu MechSum (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) : Type 0 with
| mechInl : A -> MechSum A B
| mechInr : B -> MechSum A B

mu MechDecidable (0 P : Prop) : Type 0 with
| mechIsFalse : (0 refute : P -> MechFalse) -> MechDecidable P
| mechIsTrue : (0 proof : P) -> MechDecidable P

def MechPi : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) -> B x

def MechSigma : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) * B x

def mechBoolRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> A -> A -> MechBool -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (no : A) (yes : A) (b : MechBool) =>
    case b as self in MechBool return A with
    | mechFalse => no
    | mechTrue => yes

def mechEmptyElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechEmpty -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechEmpty) =>
    case e as self in MechEmpty return A with

def mechFalseElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechFalse -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechFalse) =>
    case e as self in MechFalse return A with

def mechSumRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) ->
    (0 C : Type 0) -> (A -> C) -> (B -> C) -> MechSum A B -> C :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 C : Type 0)
    (left : A -> C) (right : B -> C) (s : MechSum A B) =>
      case s as self in MechSum return C with
      | mechInl a => left a
      | mechInr b => right b

def rec mechNatRec : (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) -> P mechZero ->
    ((n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) -> (n : MechNat) -> P n :=
  fun (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) (zero : P mechZero)
    (step : (n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) (n : MechNat) =>
      case n as self in MechNat return P self with
      | mechZero => zero
      | mechSucc previous => step previous (mechNatRec P zero step previous)

def mechDecidableBool : (0 P : Prop) -> MechDecidable P -> MechBool :=
  fun (0 P : Prop) (d : MechDecidable P) =>
    case d as self in MechDecidable return MechBool with
    | mechIsFalse 0 refute => mechFalse
    | mechIsTrue 0 proof => mechTrue

-- Equality keeps its endpoints erased and carries no constructor field.
-- The singleton criterion therefore admits elimination into data.
mu MechEq (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) : (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechReflCtor : MechEq A x x

def mechRefl : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> MechEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) => mechReflCtor

def mechJ : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) ->
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0) ->
    P x (mechRefl A x) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechEq A x y) -> P y e :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A)
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0)
    (reflCase : P x (mechRefl A x)) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return P right self with
      | mechReflCtor => reflCase

def mechTransport : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> B x -> B y :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) (value : B x) =>
      mechJ A x (fun (0 right : A) (0 proof : MechEq A x right) => B right)
        value y e

def mechSymm : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
    case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq A right x with
    | mechReflCtor => mechRefl A x

def mechTrans : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 z : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y z -> MechEq A x z :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (0 z : A)
    (first : MechEq A x y) (second : MechEq A y z) =>
      case second as self in MechEq right return MechEq A x right with
      | mechReflCtor => first

def mechCongr : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) -> (0 f : A -> B) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> MechEq B (f x) (f y) :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 f : A -> B)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq B (f x) (f right) with
      | mechReflCtor => mechRefl B (f x)

-- The older proof equality has a relevant constructor witness, so it
-- remains an example whose elimination into data is rejected.
mu MechProofEq (0 A : Prop) : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechProofReflCtor : (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x

def mechProofRefl : (0 A : Prop) -> (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Prop) (x : A) => mechProofReflCtor x

def mechProofJ : (0 A : Prop) ->
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop) ->
    ((x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x)) ->

    ((fun (x : C) => Base_Target_id D d (F.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Base_Source_Hom C c x y) =>
       Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y))
       (Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 y) (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (Base_Target_id D d (F.1 y)))
       (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f)
       (Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (Base_Target_id D d (F.1 x)) (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f))
       (Base_Target_compId D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f))
       (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y))
       (Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (Base_Target_id D d (F.1 x)) (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f))
       (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (Base_Target_idComp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f)))))

-- Two naturality squares compose using the category laws.
def vcompLaw : (0 D : Sort (succ w)) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (0 fx : D) -> (0 fy : D) -> (0 gx : D) -> (0 gy : D) -> (0 hx : D) -> (0 hy : D) ->
    (0 fm : Base_Target_Hom D d fx fy) -> (0 gm : Base_Target_Hom D d gx gy) -> (0 hm : Base_Target_Hom D d hx hy) ->
    (0 ax : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gx) -> (0 ay : Base_Target_Hom D d fy gy) ->
    (0 bx : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hx) -> (0 by : Base_Target_Hom D d gy hy) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm) :=
  fun (0 D : Sort (succ w)) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (0 fx : D) (0 fy : D) (0 gx : D) (0 gy : D) (0 hx : D) (0 hy : D)
      (0 fm : Base_Target_Hom D d fx fy) (0 gm : Base_Target_Hom D d gx gy) (0 hm : Base_Target_Hom D d hx hy)
      (0 ax : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gx) (0 ay : Base_Target_Hom D d fy gy)
      (0 bx : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hx) (0 by : Base_Target_Hom D d gy hy)
      (first : Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm))
      (second : Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm)) =>
    Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
      (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
        (Base_Target_assoc D d fx fy gy hy fm ay by))
      (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
        (Base_Target_eqCongr (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
          (fun (h : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) => Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy h by)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) first)
        (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by))
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
          (Base_Target_assoc D d fx gx gy hy ax gm by)
          (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by))
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm))
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
            (Base_Target_eqCongr (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
              (fun (h : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) => Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax h)
              (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm) second)
            (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
              (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
              (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm))
              (Base_Target_assoc D d fx gx hx hy ax bx hm)))))

-- Vertical composition applies alpha first, then beta.
def vcomp : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (c : Base_Source_Category C) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (F : Base_Functor C D c d) -> (G : Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (H : Base_Functor C D c d) -> NatTrans C D c d F G ->
    NatTrans C D c d G H -> NatTrans C D c d F H :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w))
      (c : Base_Source_Category C) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (F : Base_Functor C D c d) (G : Base_Functor C D c d) (H : Base_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) (beta : NatTrans C D c d G H) =>
    ((fun (x : C) =>
       Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (H.1 x) (alpha.1 x) (beta.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Base_Source_Hom C c x y) =>
       vcompLaw D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (H.1 x) (H.1 y)
         (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (Base_functorMap C D c d G x y f)
         (Base_functorMap C D c d H x y f) (alpha.1 x) (alpha.1 y) (beta.1 x) (beta.1 y)
         (naturality C D c d F G alpha x y f) (naturality C D c d G H beta x y f)))
end

| mechTrue : MechBool

def MechPi : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=

def mechBoolRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> A -> A -> MechBool -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (no : A) (yes : A) (b : MechBool) =>
    case b as self in MechBool return A with
    | mechFalse => no
    | mechTrue => yes

def mechEmptyElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechEmpty -> A :=

def mechFalseElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechFalse -> A :=

def mechSumRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) ->

  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 C : Type 0)
    (left : A -> C) (right : B -> C) (s : MechSum A B) =>
      case s as self in MechSum return C with

    ((n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) -> (n : MechNat) -> P n :=
  fun (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) (zero : P mechZero)

      case n as self in MechNat return P self with
      | mechZero => zero

-- Equality keeps its endpoints erased and carries no constructor field.
-- The singleton criterion therefore admits elimination into data.
mu MechEq (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) : (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechReflCtor : MechEq A x x

def mechRefl : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> MechEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) => mechReflCtor

def mechJ : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) ->
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0) ->
    P x (mechRefl A x) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechEq A x y) -> P y e :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A)
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0)
    (reflCase : P x (mechRefl A x)) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return P right self with
      | mechReflCtor => reflCase

    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> B x -> B y :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) (value : B x) =>
      mechJ A x (fun (0 right : A) (0 proof : MechEq A x right) => B right)
        value y e

def mechSymm : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
    case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq A right x with
    | mechReflCtor => mechRefl A x

    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y z -> MechEq A x z :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (0 z : A)
    (first : MechEq A x y) (second : MechEq A y z) =>
      case second as self in MechEq right return MechEq A x right with
      | mechReflCtor => first

def mechCongr : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) -> (0 f : A -> B) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> MechEq B (f x) (f y) :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 f : A -> B)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq B (f x) (f right) with
      | mechReflCtor => mechRefl B (f x)

-- The older proof equality has a relevant constructor witness, so it
-- remains an example whose elimination into data is rejected.
mu MechProofEq (0 A : Prop) : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechProofReflCtor : (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x

def mechProofRefl : (0 A : Prop) -> (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Prop) (x : A) => mechProofReflCtor x

def mechProofJ : (0 A : Prop) ->
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop) ->
    ((x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x)) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechProofEq A x y) -> P x y e :=
  fun (0 A : Prop)
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop)
    (reflCase : (x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x))
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechProofEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechProofEq left right return P left right self with
      | mechProofReflCtor witness => reflCase witness

-- Categories have independent object and morphism Type levels.
-- The equality family and all members specialize together.
poly (u, v) mu MechCategoryCore (0 A : Sort (succ v)) (0 x : A) :
    (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| categoryRefl : MechCategoryCore A x x

def Category : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ (succ v))) :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) =>
    (hom : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> Sort (succ v)) *
    (identity : (0 x : Obj) -> hom x x) *
    (compose : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 z : Obj) ->
      hom x y -> hom y z -> hom x z) *
    (left : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : hom x y) ->
      MechCategoryCore (hom x y) (compose x x y (identity x) f) f) *
    (right : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : hom x y) ->
      MechCategoryCore (hom x y) (compose x y y f (identity y)) f) *

-- Two naturality squares compose using the category laws.
def vcompLaw : (0 D : Sort (succ w)) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->

    (0 bx : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hx) -> (0 by : Base_Target_Hom D d gy hy) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm) :=
  fun (0 D : Sort (succ w)) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (0 fx : D) (0 fy : D) (0 gx : D) (0 gy : D) (0 hx : D) (0 hy : D)
      (0 fm : Base_Target_Hom D d fx fy) (0 gm : Base_Target_Hom D d gx gy) (0 hm : Base_Target_Hom D d hx hy)
      (0 ax : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gx) (0 ay : Base_Target_Hom D d fy gy)
      (0 bx : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hx) (0 by : Base_Target_Hom D d gy hy)
      (first : Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm))
      (second : Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm)) =>
    Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
      (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))

        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
        (Base_Target_eqCongr (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)

          (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) first)
        (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by))
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
          (Base_Target_assoc D d fx gx gy hy ax gm by)
          (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by))
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm))
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)

              (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm))
              (Base_Target_assoc D d fx gx hx hy ax bx hm)))))

-- Vertical composition applies alpha first, then beta.
def vcomp : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (c : Base_Source_Category C) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (F : Base_Functor C D c d) -> (G : Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (H : Base_Functor C D c d) -> NatTrans C D c d F G ->
    NatTrans C D c d G H -> NatTrans C D c d F H :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w))
      (c : Base_Source_Category C) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (F : Base_Functor C D c d) (G : Base_Functor C D c d) (H : Base_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) (beta : NatTrans C D c d G H) =>
    ((fun (x : C) =>
       Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (H.1 x) (alpha.1 x) (beta.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Base_Source_Hom C c x y) =>
       vcompLaw D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (H.1 x) (H.1 y)
         (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (Base_functorMap C D c d G x y f)
         (Base_functorMap C D c d H x y f) (alpha.1 x) (alpha.1 y) (beta.1 x) (beta.1 y)
         (naturality C D c d F G alpha x y f) (naturality C D c d G H beta x y f)))
end

-- test/circuit-spine.kan: veil D-7/D-8 circuit fragment spine, wave 0
-- part (b) ii.  Every admitted circuit form and every REACHABLE D-7
-- refused head gets one top-level definition.  `kanon circuit` prints
-- one line per definition below, `NAME: depth D` or `NAME: refused:
-- HEAD`, and exits 1 because refused definitions are present by design.
--
-- D-7 names eleven head words.  Four are reachable at this pin and
-- each gets a sample: `mu`, `unbounded iteration`, `unknown global
-- NAME`, `opaque callee`.  The `mu` sample (`spineCount` below) also
-- proves a kernel repair made in wave 0, part (b) ii: before it,
-- `Circuit.depth` looped forever on any `def rec` that passed the
-- structural termination guard of `lib/totality.ml`.  That guard puts
-- the recursive call behind a `fun`/`match` boundary, and the closure
-- made inside the global's body was applied later under the caller's
-- own `seen` list, which no longer named the global being unfolded, so
-- the cycle check never fired.  A closure value now carries the `seen`
-- list in force where it was written (`VClo of Term.leg * value list *
-- string list`), and `apply_all` evaluates the body under the union of
-- that captured list and the current one.  The `spineCount` line below
-- is the proof: it returns `refused: mu` at once instead of hanging.
--   `SPar`, `SNu`  refused as whole shapes by rules.ml (`SPar arrives
--     at M1`, `SNu arrives at M2`) before `circuit` ever runs, and no
--     surface syntax constructs a checked term of either shape here.
--   `SZk`, `SFhc`, `SMpc`  likewise refused as whole shapes (`arrives
--     at V1/V2/V3`); waves 1-3 add the surface syntax that first makes
--     them reachable.
--   `host op`  no reactor host-op construct exists anywhere in the
--     surface language or the kernel term type at this pin (`Term.t`
--     has no host-op constructor), so `Circuit.depth` has no code path
--     that ever answers this head; it is dead code in the D-7
--     vocabulary until a host op is added.
--   `auto`  `lib/check.ml` refuses `Term.Auto` outright ("instances
--     arrive at M2") before a definition that uses it can become part
--     of a checked file, so `kanon circuit` never sees one: the whole
--     file would fail `kanon check` first, not print a `circuit`
--     refusal line.
--
-- `kanon check test/circuit-spine.kan` exits 0 (the file is well
-- typed); `kanon circuit test/circuit-spine.kan` exits 1 (some
-- definitions below are refused, by design).

mu N : Type 0 :=

  fun (0 i : N) (v : V i) =>
    match v as self in V j return Nat with

    | cons (0 j : N) (x : Nat) (xs : V j) => natAdd x (total j xs)

mu C : Type 0 :=
| again (a : A) : C

  match a as self in A return Nat with
  | leaf => 0
  | node b => natAdd 1 (sizeB b)
and sizeB : B -> Nat := fun (b : B) =>
  match b as self in B return Nat with
  | bridge (c : C) => natAdd 1 (sizeC c)
and sizeC : C -> Nat := fun (c : C) =>
  match c as self in C return Nat with

  fun (c : fhc 0 Nat) => eval ((fun (x : Nat) => natAdd x 1) : (y : Nat) -> Nat) c
def reveal : (1 k : Sk) -> (c : fhc 1 Nat) -> Nat :=

def Party : Prop := sum (prod (), prod ())
def alice : Party := inj 0 of 2 ()
def bob : Party := inj 1 of 2 ()
def allParties : prod (Nat, Nat) := tuple (1, 1)

def both : (q : prod (Nat, Nat)) -> Prop :=

def secretB : Nat := 1

  fun (1 a : Nat) (1 b : Nat) =>

  fun (0 h : both allParties) (1 c : mpc[Party, fun (0 q : prod (Nat, Nat)) => isTrue (natEq (natAdd q.0 q.1) 2)] Nat) =>
